source: Cloud Billing Catalog API (services.skus.list), read with `sky ai cloud prices`; public list prices in USD, region us-central1 (Iowa, Americas)
note: Each rate is the sum of its catalogue SKUs, rounded up. Vertex AI custom training bills the machine (cores, RAM, GPU), its management fee and the boot disk; Cloud Run with a GPU bills instance-based CPU, memory and the GPU per second.

rates.cloudRunL4InstanceParts: L4 without zonal redundancy 0.0001867/s = 0.67212/h; 5 vCPU x 0.000018/s = 0.324/h; 20 GiB x 0.000002/GiB-s = 0.144/h; sum 1.14012

stageWorstCaseBasis.l1: two Cloud Build builds of at most 40 minutes together, and about 25 GB of images kept for under a day
stageWorstCaseBasis.l3: three n2-standard-4 jobs capped at 15 minutes each by their runtime ceiling
stageWorstCaseBasis.l4: one g2-standard-4 job capped at 40 minutes
stageWorstCaseBasis.l5: one Cloud Run L4 instance for at most 45 minutes
